test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jan, 2024 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

They built a new house last year.

options.text: A new house was being built by them last year.
They had been building a new house last year.
A new house was built by them last year.
A new house is being built by them last year.

solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. A new house was built by them last year.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the active voice, the subject "**they**" performs the action "**built**" on the object "a new house."
 
• In the passive voice, the object **"a new house" **becomes the subject.
 
• The verb "**built**" changes to "was built" to match the tense and maintain the passive construction.
 
• The original sentence’s time reference **"last year"** remains the same.

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.
